items.statement: DEX collection period is 50-60 days with virtually no bad debts and milestone-driven payments
items.quote: the collection period for DEX and I'm specifically mentioning this because of certain historical baggage that we have working with government and organizations in the past is typically about 50 to 60 days so this is a business where bad debts have been virtually non-existent. Payments happen on time and are largely milestone driven

items.statement: Warrants issued to Investee Global fully paid; 26.7 lakh shares allotted in September, raising promoter holding to 9.23%
items.quote: Also, we have received full payment against the warrants issued to Mauritius-based fund, Investee Global, in the month of May. And in this current month, in the month of September, we are allotted 26.7 lakh shares. With this, the total FY holding in our company has increased to 9.23%.

items.statement: ESOPs issued to four senior employees last year; five more employees to receive ESOPs in current quarter
items.quote: Also, we have issued ESOPs to four senior employees last year. And we are also in the process of issuing to five more employees in the current quarter.

items.statement: Inventory reduced from Rs 727 cr to Rs 618 cr over three quarters; charge-offs are accounting only and do not affect monetization potential or free cash flow generation
items.quote: Our inventory has come down from Rs. 727 crores as on 31st December, 2023, to Rs. 618 crores as of 30th September, 2024, which is about Rs. 100 crores, a little more than Rs. 100 crores in three quarters.

items.statement: CFO transition announced with Amol Gupta taking over from Devinder Khurana who becomes Senior VP
items.quote: I would like to announce now that M r. Amol Gupta has taken over the charge of CFO from Dr. Devinder Khurana. Mr. Amol Gupta has been with the company for a few years now and was being mentored for the CFO role as the process of succession plan

items.statement: Operating cash flows remain positive; used Rs 75 crore cash deposit from March 2024 for Kharif operations
items.quote: The operating cash flows remain positive, although we used the cash deposit of 75 crores as of March 24th for the current Kharif operations.

items.statement: Cash flow from operations was INR31 crores after reduction of advances of creditors, realization of inventory, and trade receivables
items.quote: Cash flow from operation of the company is INR31 crores after reduction of advances of creditors, realization of inventory, and trade receivables, and other measures taken by our company from time to time.

items.statement: Cash reserves stood at Rs.341 crores as of September 30, 2024
items.quote: As of September 30, 2024, our cash reserves stood at Rs.341 crores.

items.statement: Rights issue completed in October, oversubscribed more than 3x
items.quote: we have completed the rights issue just now, just in the month of October, which was over -subscribed more than 3 x.

items.statement: Term loan of Rs. 9.73 crores repaid using rights issue proceeds and internal accruals
items.quote: we have already repaid a loan of Rs. 9.73 crores, some loan repayment supported by the rights issue and our internal accrual

items.statement: Interest cost saving expected in coming quarter due to loan repayment
items.quote: immediately after receipt of the right to proceed, repay the term loan and that will help in the coming quarter in saving the interest cost

items.statement: Properties will become mortgage-free after loan repayment
items.quote: Also, we will have saving in interest cost in the coming quarter. So, this is a very positive development which happened in the month of October just to update all of you.

items.statement: Company has good liquidity and balance sheet improving
items.quote: We have given a cash flow. We have quite good liquidity in hand. And as well as the balance is also looking further improved compared to the earlier period.

items.statement: Promoter holding at 36.84%, sizable public holding
items.quote: As you know, only 36.84% they hold. So, a sizable public holding is also there.

items.statement: Board strengthened by appointing Mr. R. Kannan
items.quote: Further, we have also strengthened our Board by bringing one of the well -known personalities, Mr. R. Kannan in the Board.

items.statement: Income tax refund assessment ongoing, hoping for resolution this financial year
items.quote: Further about the income tax refund, yes Vikram, that is there which is taking time, assessment is going on. We are continuously in the discussion with the income tax regulators also.

items.statement: Receivables actively monitored with freight credit insurance from SBI Life
items.quote: About the receivables, as a company, we actively monitor and as risk mitigation measures, we have taken freight credit insurance also from the SBI Life.

items.statement: Consolidated net cash from operating activities was INR340 crores in H1 FY25, up from INR303 crores in H1 FY24.
items.quote: we have generated net cash from operating activities for th e first half to the tune of almost INR340 crores, which last year for the same first half was INR303 crores

items.statement: Standalone cash flow from operating activities was INR198 crores in Q2 FY25.
items.quote: if I just speak about the current quarter, the overall for th e stand-alone cash flow generated from operating activities is INR198 crores

items.statement: Consolidated debt reduced by INR57 crores in Q2 FY25 despite weak revenue and earnings.
items.quote: we have reduced the debt by almost close to INR57 crores during the quarter, despite this being a weak quarter in terms of overall revenue and earnings.

items.statement: Maintenance capex for H1 FY25 was INR94 crores, similar to last year.
items.quote: our over all investment into maintenance capex, etcetera, is almost same as last year at this time for the first half, close to about INR94 crores

items.statement: Rivulis is a competitor in India, a customer for exports, and Jain Irrigation holds a stake in Rivulis' parent company from a past deal.
items.quote: We continue to hold the stake into the company. The y continue to buy products from us. We continue to compete with them in India. Those are t he facts. They are all transparent. They are all arm's length. They are all market based

items.statement: Jain Irrigation will not invest new money from the parent into the food processing subsidiary; expects subsidiary to improve its balance sheet on its own.
items.quote: No. We would not be investing new money out of the parent into the subsidiary. I think we would expect subsidiary on its own to improve its balance sheet.
